notes: Live PPPoE sessions no longer look dead after an agent restart. A zip hot-update restarts the agent without rebooting: pppd keeps running and the ip-up hook never fires again, but the boot reset cleared every session's runtime interface name anyway -- so traffic showed 0 bps and the health check forced the session offline while the line carried traffic. It now clears only sessions whose interface no longer holds an address. The status pill also contradicted itself, colouring by the public address but printing the stored status, so a working session could render green and read "offline"; both now come from one decision. DNS proxies are updated after a reboot: the call used to go out before the policy routing rule existed and was never retried, and it only fired when the address changed -- it now runs after the routing apply with retries, and every DNS proxy is refreshed once per boot regardless.
